s0201.literal: Prince Yezhen's retainers were starving; five thousand households were sent to find food at Jinan.
s0201.idiomatic: Prince Yezhen's retainers were starving, and 5,000 households were sent to find food at Jinan.

s0202.literal: In Tang County, Baoding Circuit, wild silkworm cocoons yielded silk that could be made into cloth.
s0202.idiomatic: In Tang County, Baoding Circuit, wild silkworm cocoons yielded silk usable for cloth.

s0203.literal: On renzi day three hundred ten garrison troops under Woduan were ordered to garrison-farm.
s0203.idiomatic: On renzi day 310 garrison troops under Woduan were ordered to garrison-farm.

s0204.literal: The Six Guards were ordered to manufacture weapons.
s0204.idiomatic: The Six Guards were ordered to manufacture weapons.

s0205.literal: Eighth month, guichou day, Prince Yezhen said: "I recently led the Mongol troops under my Jining appanage east on campaign; their families all lack food. I ask that the annual tax silver of Jinan Circuit be granted so they may exchange it for rice to eat.
s0205.idiomatic: Eighth month, guichou day, Prince Yezhen said, "I recently led the Mongol troops under my Jining appanage east on campaign, and their families all lack food. I ask that Jinan Circuit's annual tax silver be granted so they may exchange it for rice to eat."

s0206.literal: " An edict ordered Liaoyang Province to provide ten thousand shi of grain for relief.
s0206.idiomatic: An edict ordered Liaoyang Province to provide 10,000 shi of grain for relief.

s0207.literal: On bingchen day Mars transgressed Fang.
s0207.idiomatic: On bingchen day Mars transgressed Fang.

s0208.literal: Pingxiang County of Yuan presented auspicious grain.
s0208.idiomatic: Pingxiang County of Yuan presented auspicious grain.

s0209.literal: An edict ordered Antong to lead three hundred Keshig Mongol troops of his command on a northern campaign.
s0209.idiomatic: An edict ordered Antong to lead 300 Keshig Mongol troops of his command on a northern campaign.

s0210.literal: On jiwei day Venus transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0210.idiomatic: On jiwei day Venus transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0211.literal: On xinyou day school-field rents in Jiang Prefecture were remitted.
s0211.idiomatic: On xinyou day school-field rents in Jiang Prefecture were remitted.

s0212.literal: On guihai day the Central Secretariat building was completed.
s0212.idiomatic: On guihai day the Central Secretariat building was completed.

s0213.literal: On renshen day, within Anxi Province there was great famine; more than twenty-one thousand five hundred shi of field rent was remitted, and grain was lent for relief.
s0213.idiomatic: On renshen day Anxi Province suffered great famine; more than 21,500 shi of field rent was remitted and grain was lent for relief.

s0214.literal: On guiyou day the Hejian and other circuits' salt transport bureau was made concurrently to administer the three ironworks of Shunde, Guangping, and Qiyang.
s0214.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Hejian and other circuits' salt transport bureau was also placed in charge of the Shunde, Guangping, and Qiyang ironworks.

s0215.literal: On bingzi day three thousand shi of grain was issued to relieve famine victims under Mieji'erdai.
s0215.idiomatic: On bingzi day 3,000 shi of grain was issued to relieve famine victims under Mieji'erdai.

s0216.literal: Locusts afflicted the three prefectures of Zhao, Jin, and Ji.
s0216.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted Zhao, Jin, and Ji prefectures.

s0217.literal: On dingchou day, in Jiuxiang, Yutai, and Jinxiang counties heavy rain damaged crops; five thousand shi of rent was remitted.
s0217.idiomatic: On dingchou day heavy rain damaged crops in Jiuxiang, Yutai, and Jinxiang counties, and 5,000 shi of rent was remitted.

s0218.literal: On gengchen day the imperial carriage halted at Boluohainao'er.
s0218.idiomatic: On gengchen day the imperial carriage halted at Boluohainao'er.

s0219.literal: Because Xianping had repeatedly suffered from military disorder, grain from Shenzhou granaries was issued for relief.
s0219.idiomatic: Because Xianping had repeatedly suffered military disorder, grain from Shenzhou granaries was issued for relief.

s0220.literal: The Wan'yi Treasury was divided into four treasuries: Baoyuan, Fuyuan, Qiyuan, and Guangyuan.
s0220.idiomatic: The Wan'yi Treasury was divided into four treasuries: Baoyuan, Fuyuan, Qiyuan, and Guangyuan.

s0221.literal: Ninth month, on the guimwei new moon, Mars transgressed Tianjiang.
s0221.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the guimwei new moon, Mars transgressed Tianjiang.

s0222.literal: The great carriage halted at Yehu Ridge.
s0222.idiomatic: The great carriage halted at Yehu Ridge.

s0223.literal: Ganzhou suffered drought famine; four thousand four hundred shi of overdue tax was remitted.
s0223.idiomatic: Ganzhou suffered drought famine, and 4,400 shi of overdue tax was remitted.

s0224.literal: On bingxu day post stations were established in Ting and Mei prefectures.
s0224.idiomatic: On bingxu day post stations were established in Ting and Mei prefectures.

s0225.literal: On jichou day in Xian and Mo prefectures heavy rain damaged crops; more than eight hundred shi of field rent was remitted.
s0225.idiomatic: On jichou day heavy rain damaged crops in Xian and Mo prefectures, and more than 800 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0226.literal: On renchen day the great carriage reached Dadu.
s0226.idiomatic: On renchen day the great carriage reached Dadu.

s0227.literal: On yiwei day gold-washing households in Tanzhou were abolished.
s0227.idiomatic: On yiwei day gold-washing households in Tanzhou were abolished.

s0229.literal: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Bi.
s0229.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Bi.

s0230.literal: Gui State and Jiandu both sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0230.idiomatic: Gui State and Jiandu both sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0231.literal: Following Sangge's request, five treasuries were built within the Forbidden City to store currency and silks.
s0231.idiomatic: At Sangge's request, five treasuries were built within the Forbidden City to store currency and silks.

s0232.literal: On guimao day Mars transgressed Nandou.
s0232.idiomatic: On guimao day Mars transgressed Nandou.

s0233.literal: Households under Huduhu were ordered to pay tax on land they actually occupied.
s0233.idiomatic: Households under Huduhu were ordered to pay tax on land they actually occupied.

s0234.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Since the Central Secretariat was established, every granary and bureau has been audited. A recovery bureau should be established at rank 3a, solely to pursue recoverable grain and goods. Deputy chief councillor Tulie'ehuo of the Gansu branch secretariat and secretary Wu Cheng should both serve as recovery commissioners.
s0234.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "Since the Central Secretariat was established, every granary and bureau has been audited. A recovery bureau should be established at rank 3a solely to pursue recoverable grain and goods, with Gansu branch secretariat deputy chief councillor Tulie'ehuo and secretary Wu Cheng both serving as recovery commissioners."

s0236.literal: The chief treasury of precious notes and the Yongying Treasury were both promoted to rank 5b.
s0236.idiomatic: The chief treasury of precious notes and the Yongying Treasury were both promoted to rank 5b.

s0237.literal: The Eight Workshops Office was changed to an Eight Workshops Intendant Office at rank 6a.
s0237.idiomatic: The Eight Workshops Office was changed to an Eight Workshops Intendant Office at rank 6a.

s0238.literal: Salaries of officials at the Yuanbao, Yongfeng, and Eight Workshops offices were increased.
s0238.idiomatic: Salaries of officials at the Yuanbao, Yongfeng, and Eight Workshops offices were increased.

s0239.literal: On gengxu day the Imperial Medical Academy's newly compiled Pharmacopoeia was completed.
s0239.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Imperial Medical Academy's newly compiled Pharmacopoeia was completed.

s0240.literal: Tenth month of winter, on jiwei day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0240.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on jiwei day, sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0241.literal: On gengshen day, at Sangge's request, twelve officials from the secretariat, censorate, and bureau were assigned to audit revenues and grain accounts in the six provinces of Jiang-Huai, Jiangxi, Fujian, Sichuan, Gansu, and Anxi, with soldiers assigned as guards.
s0241.idiomatic: On gengshen day, at Sangge's request, twelve officials from the secretariat, censorate, and bureau were assigned to audit revenues and grain in Jiang-Huai, Jiangxi, Fujian, Sichuan, Gansu, and Anxi, with soldiers as guards.

s0242.literal: U-Tsang pacification commissioner Ruannu Wangshu had once relieved famine among military-post households in his jurisdiction; Sangge requested a reward, and two thousand five hundred taels of silver were granted.
s0242.idiomatic: U-Tsang pacification commissioner Ruannu Wangshu had once relieved famine among military-post households in his jurisdiction; Sangge requested a reward, and 2,500 taels of silver were granted.

s0243.literal: On jiazi day the Tiger Guard Bureau was established, then changed again to the Military Guard Bureau.
s0243.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Tiger Guard Bureau was established, then changed again to the Military Guard Bureau.

s0244.literal: On bingyin day Duke of Yingguo Zhao Qi was granted one hundred ingots of paper currency.
s0244.idiomatic: On bingyin day Duke of Yingguo Zhao Qi was granted 100 ingots of paper currency.

s0245.literal: The Ganzhou transport commission was placed under the metropolitan secretariat.
s0245.idiomatic: The Ganzhou transport commission was placed under the metropolitan secretariat.

s0246.literal: Huguang Province reported: "At the left and right river mouths the stream-cave Man and Liao have four chief controller offices ruling prefectures, counties, and one hundred sixty caves; but appointed officials fear the miasma and many dare not go. We ask that Han Chinese serve as darughachi, military officers hold civilian posts, and local people be used in mixed fashion.
s0246.idiomatic: Huguang Province reported, "At the left and right river mouths the stream-cave Man and Liao have four chief controller offices ruling prefectures, counties, and 160 caves, but appointed officials fear the miasma and many dare not go. We ask that Han Chinese serve as darughachi, military officers hold civilian posts, and local people be used in mixed fashion."

s0247.literal: " Seventy-four persons including Jiagu Sanhe were immediately nominated and reported; this was approved.
s0247.idiomatic: Seventy-four persons including Jiagu Sanhe were immediately nominated and reported; this was approved.

s0248.literal: Eight persons of Datong including Li Boxiang and Su Yongfu were executed for plotting rebellion.
s0248.idiomatic: Eight Datong men including Li Boxiang and Su Yongfu were executed for plotting rebellion.

s0249.literal: On gengwu day Haidu raided the border.
s0249.idiomatic: On gengwu day Haidu raided the border.

s0250.literal: Sangge requested that next year's sea-route grain transport from Jiangnan must reach one million shi.
s0250.idiomatic: Sangge requested that next year's sea-route grain transport from Jiangnan reach 1,000,000 shi.

s0251.literal: He also said: "From Anshan to Linqing the canal is two hundred sixty-five li.
s0251.idiomatic: He also said, "From Anshan to Linqing the canal is 265 li.

s0252.literal: If dredged, the labor would be three million, requiring thirty thousand ingots of paper currency, forty thousand shi of grain, and fifty thousand jin of salt.
s0252.idiomatic: If dredged, the labor would be 3,000,000 units, requiring 30,000 ingots of paper currency, 40,000 shi of grain, and 50,000 jin of salt.

s0253.literal: The thirteen thousand land-transport households would be returned to civilian status; their tax payments and fodder estimates amount to twenty-eight thousand ingots of paper currency, roughly equivalent in cost, yet once the canal is complete it will be a benefit for ten thousand generations.
s0253.idiomatic: The 13,000 land-transport households would be returned to civilian status; their tax payments and fodder estimates amount to 28,000 ingots of paper currency, roughly equivalent in cost, yet once the canal is complete it will be a benefit for ten thousand generations.

s0254.literal: We ask to prepare grain and expenses this winter and dredge next spring.
s0254.idiomatic: We ask to prepare grain and expenses this winter and dredge next spring.

s0256.literal: On bingzi day iron ring-mail armor began to be manufactured.
s0256.idiomatic: On bingzi day iron ring-mail armor began to be manufactured.

s0257.literal: Duke of Yingguo Zhao Qi studied Buddhist dharma in Tubo.
s0257.idiomatic: Duke of Yingguo Zhao Qi studied Buddhist dharma in Tubo.

s0258.literal: On jimao day Yebugan invaded; Budumashi led troops and fought him off vigorously.
s0258.idiomatic: On jimao day Yebugan invaded; Budumashi led troops and fought him off vigorously.

s0259.literal: Tabudai rebelled; Hulahu, Atahai, and others fought and repelled him.
s0259.idiomatic: Tabudai rebelled; Hulahu, Atahai, and others fought and repelled him.

s0260.literal: An edict remitted miscellaneous corvée for scholar households.
s0260.idiomatic: An edict remitted miscellaneous corvée for scholar households.

s0261.literal: Central Secretariat officials requested that the Academia and its bureaus audit by route the surplus income from Jiangnan prefectural school fields, store it in the Academia, and use it to support persons of many talents; this was approved.
s0261.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials requested that the Academia and its bureaus audit by route surplus income from Jiangnan prefectural school fields, store it in the Academia, and use it to support persons of many talents; this was approved.

s0263.literal: Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0263.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0264.literal: Eleventh month, on renwu day, Gongchang Circuit suffered successive famine; half the field rent was remitted, and three thousand ingots of paper currency were also granted to relieve the poor.
s0264.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renwu day, Gongchang Circuit suffered successive famine; half the field rent was remitted, and 3,000 ingots of paper currency were also granted to relieve the poor.

s0265.literal: Husaimading was appointed darughachi overseeing garrison-farming households in Gansu, Shaanxi, and elsewhere, supervising one thousand fifty artisan households at Woduan and Keshihe'er in garrison-farming.
s0265.idiomatic: Husaimading was appointed darughachi overseeing garrison-farming households in Gansu, Shaanxi, and elsewhere, supervising 1,050 artisan households at Woduan and Keshihe'er in garrison-farming.

s0266.literal: On dinghai day Jinchi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0266.idiomatic: On dinghai day Jinchi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0267.literal: He Rongzu, surveillance commissioner of the Shandong Eastern and Western Circuit, was appointed associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
s0267.idiomatic: He Rongzu, surveillance commissioner of the Shandong Eastern and Western Circuit, was appointed associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.

s0268.literal: The National Academy was repaired to house crown sons.
s0268.idiomatic: The National Academy was repaired to house crown sons.

s0269.literal: It was forbidden for fief-holding ministers to privately impress wealthy households as fuel-and-rice service households or impose corvée beyond regular levies.
s0269.idiomatic: It was forbidden for fief-holding ministers to privately impress wealthy households as fuel-and-rice service households or impose corvée beyond regular levies.

s0270.literal: Huang Deqing of Liuzhou rebelled; Cai Meng and others of Chaozhou resisted and killed government troops; all were executed.
s0270.idiomatic: Huang Deqing of Liuzhou rebelled; Cai Meng and others of Chaozhou resisted and killed government troops; all were executed.

s0271.literal: On gengyin day Cengehe led troops raiding Jianzhou, killing more than three hundred persons; Xianping suffered a great earthquake.
s0271.idiomatic: On gengyin day Cengehe led troops raiding Jianzhou, killing more than 300 persons; Xianping suffered a great earthquake.

s0272.literal: On xinmao day among famine victims in Wulianghe many died of starvation; three months' grain was issued.
s0272.idiomatic: On xinmao day many famine victims in Wulianghe died of starvation; three months' grain was issued.

s0273.literal: On renchen day the Jianchang Circuit garrison-farming chief controller office was abolished.
s0273.idiomatic: On renchen day the Jianchang Circuit garrison-farming chief controller office was abolished.

s0274.literal: On guisi day Prince Yeligan was granted fifty taels of gold, five thousand taels of silver, one thousand ingots of paper currency, and two thousand bolts of silks and gauze.
s0274.idiomatic: On guisi day Prince Yeligan was granted 50 taels of gold, 5,000 taels of silver, 1,000 ingots of paper currency, and 2,000 bolts of silks and gauze.

s0275.literal: Yesudai'er and Yalinhailasun captured the two rebel princes Niegun and Hududa'er and brought them in.
s0275.idiomatic: Yesudai'er and Yalinhailasun captured the two rebel princes Niegun and Hududa'er and brought them in.

s0276.literal: On jiawu day northern troops raided the border.
s0276.idiomatic: On jiawu day northern troops raided the border.

s0277.literal: An edict placed all within Fujian Province under the branch secretariat's command.
s0277.idiomatic: An edict placed all within Fujian Province under the branch secretariat's command.

s0278.literal: On bingshen day the people of Hemili were starving and seed could not enter the soil; Aiyachi was ordered to supply them from surplus garrison-farm grain.
s0278.idiomatic: On bingshen day the people of Hemili were starving and seed could not enter the soil; Aiyachi was ordered to supply them from surplus garrison-farm grain.

s0279.literal: On jihai day Li Siyan was appointed vice minister of rites and charged as credentialed envoy, with Wannu, bureau director in the Ministry of War, as deputy; together they were sent as envoys to Annam with an edict instructing Chen Rixuan to come to court in person, otherwise troops would again be added.
s0279.idiomatic: On jihai day Li Siyan was appointed vice minister of rites and credentialed envoy, with Wannu, bureau director in the Ministry of War, as deputy; together they were sent to Annam with an edict instructing Chen Rixuan to come to court in person, otherwise troops would again be added.

s0280.literal: Dadu residents Shi Ji and others requested erection of a stele commemorating Sangge's virtuous governance; this was approved.
s0280.idiomatic: Dadu residents Shi Ji and others requested erection of a stele commemorating Sangge's virtuous governance; this was approved.

s0281.literal: On xinchou day the kingdom of Ma-ba sent envoys to court.
s0281.idiomatic: On xinchou day the kingdom of Ma-ba sent envoys to court.

s0283.literal: On jiachen day, because the Gongchang expedient chief commander office governed military and civilian affairs in more than fifty cities and the burden was heavy, it was changed to a pacification commission, concurrently retaining the expedient chief commander office.
s0283.idiomatic: On jiachen day, because the Gongchang expedient chief commander office governed military and civilian affairs in more than 50 cities and the burden was heavy, it was changed to a pacification commission, concurrently retaining the expedient chief commander office.

s0284.literal: The Buddhist general control bureau was changed to the Xuanzheng Bureau at rank 1b; its seal used the three-terrace style; right chief councillor Sangge was made concurrent commissioner.
s0284.idiomatic: The Buddhist general control bureau was changed to the Xuanzheng Bureau at rank 1b; its seal used the three-terrace style, and right chief councillor Sangge was made concurrent commissioner.

s0285.literal: On gengxu day three hundred garrison troops were added to Xianping Prefecture.
s0285.idiomatic: On gengxu day 300 garrison troops were added to Xianping Prefecture.

s0286.literal: Twelfth month, on yimao day, Andar'a'ertu and others were granted one thousand two hundred fifty taels of gold, one hundred twenty-five thousand taels of silver, twenty-five thousand ingots of paper currency, and twenty-three thousand six hundred sixty-six bolts of silks, cloth, and felt cloth.
s0286.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on yimao day, Andar'a'ertu and others were granted 1,250 taels of gold, 125,000 taels of silver, 25,000 ingots of paper currency, and 23,666 bolts of silks, cloth, and felt cloth.

s0287.literal: Shangdu was ordered to recruit men to transport ten thousand shi of grain to Kara-Khorum; Yingchang Prefecture was to transport thirty thousand shi to supply the Qongirat army.
s0287.idiomatic: Shangdu was ordered to recruit men to transport 10,000 shi of grain to Kara-Khorum; Yingchang Prefecture was to transport 30,000 shi to supply the Qongirat army.

s0288.literal: On dingsi day Haidu's troops raided the border; Badu Yasuntuo went to meet them and died.
s0288.idiomatic: On dingsi day Haidu's troops raided the border; Badu Yasuntuo went to meet them and died.

s0289.literal: Previously Antong led troops to the border and was captured by Shiliji; the whole army was lost.
s0289.idiomatic: Previously Antong led troops to the border and was captured by Shiliji; the whole army was lost.

s0290.literal: At this time Balin came over; his followers numbered three hundred ninety persons in all, and they were granted twelve thousand five hundred thirteen ingots of paper currency.
s0290.idiomatic: At this time Balin came over; his followers numbered 390 persons in all, and they were granted 12,513 ingots of paper currency.

s0291.literal: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Bi.
s0291.idiomatic: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Bi.

s0292.literal: On guihai day the chief controller office for hunting, artisan, and other households in Dadu and other circuits was established.
s0292.idiomatic: On guihai day the chief controller office for hunting, artisan, and other households in Dadu and other circuits was established.

s0293.literal: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Jing.
s0293.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Jing.

s0294.literal: On xinwei day Sangge said: "Ministers with fiefs routinely plead poverty and hope for grants.
s0294.idiomatic: On xinwei day Sangge said, "Ministers with fiefs routinely plead poverty and hope for grants.

s0295.literal: Wealth does not fall from heaven or spring from earth; it all comes from the people. If income and outlay are not carefully managed, I fear state revenues will be insufficient.
s0295.idiomatic: Wealth does not fall from heaven or spring from earth; it all comes from the people. If income and outlay are not carefully managed, I fear state revenues will be insufficient."

s0296.literal: " The Emperor said: "From now on, whatever ought not be granted you mark off at once; what ought to be granted should be reported back for review, and I will decide myself.
s0296.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "From now on, whatever ought not be granted you mark off at once; what ought to be granted should be reported back for review, and I will decide myself."

s0297.literal: " On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Kang and Mars transgressed Leibi.
s0297.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed Kang and Mars transgressed Leibi.

s0298.literal: Prince of Anxi Ananda came reporting that soldiers were starving and also lacked camels; an edict granted six thousand shi of grain and one hundred camels.
s0298.idiomatic: Prince of Anxi Ananda came reporting that soldiers were starving and also lacked camels; an edict granted 6,000 shi of grain and 100 camels.

s0299.literal: On yihai day the Hutou bandit Zhang Zhinan plundered Quanzhou; Quanzhou's field rent for the year was remitted.
s0299.idiomatic: On yihai day the Hutou bandit Zhang Zhinan plundered Quanzhou; Quanzhou's field rent for the year was remitted.

s0300.literal: On bingzi day Yesu Buqa reported that Shiremen had rebelled.
s0300.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yesu Buqa reported that Shiremen had rebelled.
